firstPlayerRule: Give the First Player marker to the youngest player. They take the first turn, and play continues clockwise.
houseFallback: If your group cannot use the age criterion, agree to choose randomly. That is an optional house rule.
clarifications: The cited refreshed edition includes a First Player marker. This entry does not cover Splendor Duel.
